caption: The drawing depicts two black and brown cowboy boots placed on a plain, light beige background. One boot is upright with two brown pull straps at the top, showing the front and side of the boot; the upper part is brown with darker detailing and the lower part is primarily black. The other boot is lying on its side, exposing the brown sole and the black leather of the foot section, with the shaft displaying a similar brown and black color pattern as the upright boot. Both boots show texture and shading suggestive of wear. Above the boots to the right, there is a sepia-toned illustration of a horse, a tree, and a fence, with decorative flourishes in a rectangular frame, beneath which the text "See my New Boots" is written. The artist's name "HARRY ROSEN" is inscribed near the bottom right boot, and at the very bottom right, there is handwritten text "SERIES A – Frame 48" in small letters. The background is plain and unadorned except for faint cross marks near the edges, likely for alignment.
title: Boy's Boots
